question: Should TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND and isToolProgressPayload become a permanent public Plugin SDK contract for cross-plugin progress suppression?
rationale: The bug fix benefits from typed producer intent, but selecting a supported public cross-plugin API and its suppression semantics is a compatibility decision that cannot be inferred from tests or contributor proof.

options.title: Approve and document the generic contract
options.body: Keep the additive API, define which payloads may carry it and how channels may suppress them, and require exact-head end-to-end proof.

options.title: Internalize the progress signal
options.body: Move the metadata behind an internal runtime seam so the Slack fix does not establish a new external Plugin SDK contract.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Leave the PR unmerged if no owner is prepared to sponsor permanent cross-plugin progress semantics.

recommendation.title: Approve and document the generic contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive API, define which payloads may carry it and how channels may suppress them, and require exact-head end-to-end proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to current Slack delivery and adjacent Plugin SDK integration decisions.
